name: Motorized Bicycle or Tricycle
description: A bicycle or tricycle, pedals optional, with a motor rated 1.5 brake horsepower (1,125 W) or less that can propel it unassisted at no more than 25 mph. An e-bike past an electric bicycle's limits but within these lands here rather than as a moped; it can't be registered and is ridden under the bicycle rules, at no more than 20 mph.

restrictions.rule: A bicycle or tricycle with a motor attached to a wheel; pedals are optional
Its motor is rated 1.5 brake horsepower (1,125 W) or less and can propel it unassisted at no more than 25 mph on a level road
Excludes electric bicycles; the BMV sorts an electric two- or three-wheeler within these limits here, and one past them but under 1,500 watts as a moped
Can't be registered, and needs no inspection
Riders need a driver's license of any class, a learner's permit, or a license endorsed for a motorcycle or moped; the Secretary of State can't require the endorsement
Ridden under the rules of the road for bicycles, including on paved shoulders, and never faster than 20 mph; a rider 17 or older who breaks them is fined $25 to $250
A police chief may impound one ridden against the bicycle rules by a rider under 17, for up to 5 days for a first offense, 10 for a second and 30 after that
